note: Allein überlebst du laut Profil kaum und folgst einem großen Fleischfresser als Freund. Genau das tun einzelne Goldschakale, die sich einem Tiger anschließen. Der Rattenschwarm tritt in den Hintergrund.

analogs.covers: Solo life: a lone outcast that attaches itself to one big predator, lives off its kills and calls loudly for company
Diet and caution: bones and rotting scraps, and a sleeping spot tucked away from big feet

solo.headline: A lone jackal that has adopted a giant: it follows one big carnivore everywhere, calls for company and lives on bones and stolen scraps.
solo.playsLike: Alone, a Compsognathus barely survives. You pick a large carnivorous friend, usually a Tyrannosaurus or Giganotosaurus, and follow it for scraps, or you call until other Compsognathus form a swarm with you. You eat bones, rotting corpses and chunks stolen from other predators' kills, keep a wide berth from herbivores (except Citipati, who may adopt you) and approach any carnivore with curiosity. Around your chosen giant you nip at other scavengers, up to 3 times without it counting as an engagement. You sleep on high perches out of the way of trampling feet.

why.text: Solitary Compsognathus “seek out a large carnivorous friend to follow, relying on it to provide scavenging opportunities”. In India lone golden jackals are known to attach themselves to a tiger and live off its kills.
Solitary Compsognathus “are very vocal and call out frequently for a companion”, as jackals wail to keep contact.
On its own it lives “mainly on bones, rotting corpses, and stealing chunks” from other predators' kills, a jackal's and a rat's menu at once.
Around its chosen carnivore it nips other scavengers, up to 3 times without starting an engagement, the way a jackal snaps at rivals at a lion's kill.
It finds high perches and comfortable places to sleep, out of the way of larger dinosaurs that might trample it.

notLike: Jackals are much bigger relative to their prey; Compsognathus is the smallest carnivore on the roster (Tiny, 400 combat weight).
A jackal never pesters lions to play; a solitary Compsognathus screeches at other dinosaurs and darts off until they finally aggress it.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein einsamer Goldschakal, der sich einen Riesen ausgesucht hat. Allein kommst du kaum zurecht, also folgst du einem großen Fleischfresser, meist einem Tyrannosaurus oder Giganotosaurus, und lebst von seinen Resten, oder du rufst so lange, bis sich andere Compsognathus mit dir zu einem Schwarm zusammentun. Du frisst Knochen, verrottende Kadaver und stibitzt Brocken von fremden Rissen. Du rufst ständig nach Gesellschaft, neckst andere Dinosaurier mit Gekreisch und flitzt davon. Pflanzenfressern gehst du aus dem Weg, außer Citipati, die dich adoptieren können. Andere Aasfresser an deinem Riesen zwickst du weg, höchstens dreimal, ohne dass es als Kampf zählt. Geschlafen wird hoch oben, wo dich keiner zertrampelt.
